I went for an appointment to get my dog spayed. I made the appointment online and received a very general email to be at the site at 7 am. I would need proof of residence and proof of rabies vaccination. I arrived at 7 am and was told to stay in the car. Around 8:30 am or so I was one step closer to starting the appointment. A staff member verified my paperwork for vaccination and I was eventually allowed in by a nice guy in a purple polo. My dog was weighed, her chip was verified and then I waited some more. My dog sat in a cage and I in a chair waiting for the front desk to attend us. What I thought would take an hour tops was starting to hit the 2 hour mark. Once attended by the front desk I started getting asked about the rabies vaccine. I provided proof as the email stated but they wanted a certificate. The health certificate wasn’t enough. Once I agreed to have my dog vaccinated redundantly just to go through with getting spayed they told me it would be $80 +. I thought ok it’s more but let’s do it. I drove an hour to Homestead and found myself having to postpone work meetings because this was looking like an all day affair. Once that was also squared away they said they needed certification for the chip. Smh. No where in the email or in any information I read was this asked for. At this point it’s about 9:45 am. The front desk at this place creates such a bottle neck for this place. There is a huge lack of efficiency and consideration for people’s time and effort in complying with vague instructions. Aside from the front desk piecemealing information they blame another aspect of the organization when I’m upset. Honestly it’s all the same to me. I left with my dog. There were two kind staff members: the woman in scrubs who came out to the car and the gentleman inside w/ a purple polo. Sadly their kindness can’t carry the lack of professionalism and inefficiency of this place. I feel bad for all the people told to come pick up their pets at 2 pm. By the time they leave they’ll be stuck in rush hour with a drugged up pet wanting to get home.

Would like to start by saying I don’t normally leave reviews but had the worst experience ever at this place! Brought my dog here to get neutered back in April 23rd and ended up having to take him somewhere else for emergency surgery. After picking him up he was kept supervised safe and with a cone at all times at home. Avoid this place for this type of procedure. I was given no pain meds and the surgery was unsuccessful.
